title: N Scale B&O Baltimore & Ohio 3-Bay Covered Hopper #837082 Gray Freight Car
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Model Railroads & Trains:Railroads & Trains:Freight Cars
conditionDescription: Chipped/cracked roof walk corner and rough plastic on one end panel. Trucks roll freely, couplers intact.
descriptionText:
N scale 3-bay covered hopper car in Baltimore & Ohio (B&O) gray with the Capitol dome herald, road number 837082. Lettered BLT 5-35, CAPY 140000, LD LMT 148300, LT WT 49600, CU FT 3420, with "This car has three compartments" on the side. Roof walk, hatches, end ladders and hopper outlet detail; body-mounted trucks with metal wheels.
No manufacturer name on the car. About 4 1/2 inches long over the couplers (see the photo with the tape measure).
Condition: Pre-owned. One end has a chipped, cracked roof walk corner and rough plastic along that end panel (see photos). Lettering is crisp, trucks roll freely and couplers are intact. Please review all photos - they are of the actual car you will receive.
